subject: Re: Prioritization change — pausing BlueOak inference demo
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@blueoaklabs.com>, Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@blueoaklabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Demo confirmation and agenda — Wed 9/1 10:00am PT

Hi Ava / Ethan,

Thanks again for the time on the call today — I’ve booked a 45-minute walkthrough for Wednesday, 9/1 at 10:00am PT. We’ll cover:
- Quick product intro (10 mins)
- Inference demo with latency/cost controls (20 mins)
- Q&A + next steps / pilot scope (15 mins)

I’m including Karthik from solutions so we can show the latency profile and quantization options tailored to BlueOak’s 20k qps batch case. Attached is a short demo agenda and the initial data flow diagram we discussed.

If anything changes on your end, please let me know — otherwise we’ll see you Wed.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0192
attachments: initial-demo-agenda.pdf
From: Ava Chen <ava@blueoaklabs.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@blueoaklabs.com>, product-team@blueoaklabs.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 09:12:08 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo confirmation and agenda — Wed 9/1 10:00am PT

Jordan —

Quick update from our side: we’ve had a roadmap shift. Leadership has decided to prioritize a platform migration sprint for the rest of Q3, which pulls most of our infra and product bandwidth. Given that change, we need to park the inference/demo work for BlueOak for now.

We’re not cancelling — more putting the pilot on the backlog. I don’t have a target date yet; likely we’ll revisit in mid Q4 once the migration is stable.

Apologies for the short notice — want to avoid wasting your team’s time while we’re bandwidth constrained. Please cancel the Wed session and we’ll reach back out when we have clarity.

Thanks for understanding.
Ava
Head of Product | BlueOak Labs
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@blueoaklabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@blueoaklabs.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 10:05:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo confirmation and agenda — Wed 9/1 10:00am PT

Hi Ava — thanks for the heads up and totally understand the migration priority. We’ll cancel Wednesday’s slot on our calendar.

A couple quick notes / offers to keep momentum without adding lift to your team:
- We can send a short, self-guided demo recording (15–20 min) plus an appendix showing the latency/cost tradeoffs for your peak patterns — you can review on your own schedule.
- If it’d help, we can produce a 1-page “pilot readiness” checklist tied to migration milestones so the moment you say go we can move quickly without a new discovery.
- We’ll pause active outreach and set a reminder to check in in 6 weeks unless you tell us otherwise.

Would you prefer the recording + checklist or should we hold until you ping us? Either works.

Appreciate the transparency — wishing you a smooth migration.

Best,
Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: BlueOak migration — pause demo (internal)

FYI — BlueOak just moved us to backlog while they do a platform migration sprint. Key points:
- They explicitly asked to pause the live demo to avoid pulling engineering/product time.
- No cancellation; expect revisit in mid Q4 but no firm date.
- Deal: BO-4932. Pipeline stage: POC / proposed.

Suggested next steps:
1) Mark deal as ‘nurture — customer-driven delay’ in HubSpot and set a 6-week follow-up task. Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/BO-4932
2) Drop a short self-serve demo recording + the 1-page pilot readiness checklist (I’ll draft). This keeps value visible without claiming their time.
3) Pause any promotional credits / dev-resources hold — don’t reserve Dedicated capacity yet.

Marissa — can you put a 6-week reminder and flag for CS to check infra staffing timelines when we hit Q4? Rishi — any guidance on whether we should hold a small credit line open for them (they’re mid-market).

Thanks —
Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
